summary: Elevate your recruitment skills with our Advanced Techniques and Tools Training Course. Learn to source top talent effectively and efficiently.
lede: Recruiting and retaining top talent training covers proactive sourcing, candidate engagement, and pipeline nurturing. For HR and recruitment professionals, hiring managers, and workforce planners, it develops practical skills in advanced search and market mapping, using automation with human judgment, and engaging candidates through inclusive outreach.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals involved in talent acquisition and recruitment across various sectors. Whether you're an HR specialist or a business leader, the tools and techniques covered will enhance your ability to source and secure top talent efficiently.
audience: HR business partners and workforce planners
modules: The Modern Talent Landscape and Sourcing Evolution
Talent Intelligence, Market Mapping, and Workforce Insights
Boolean, X-Ray, and Advanced Search Mastery
AI and Automation Tools in Talent Sourcing
Social Recruiting: LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance, and Beyond
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusive Sourcing Methods
Ethical Recruiting, Confidentiality, and Bias-Free Talent Sourcing
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of recruitment and sourcing processes. Familiarity with basic recruitment tools and platforms is recommended.
